Name: Sebastian (Black Butler) as Gunther
Author: bigeyedkitteh
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/xGkPW1j.gif[/img][center]﻿Always skipping the museum?


Feel ✨inspired✨ to visit the Stardew Valley Archeology Office once more -- even if Elliott's public book reading is over, or you're not tailing Penny around, or [s]bullying[/s] making friends with Vincent, or not interested in meeting Krobus (aww :< ).

This mod spice things up a bit with Gunther's alter-ego: Sebastian Michaelis from Black Butler.

﻿[img]https://media.tenor.com/aoOJWNeEhu8AAAAC/sebastian-sebastian-michaelis.gif[/img]

***

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/DLbElBU.png[/img]

Uhmm...

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/SXtMoZX.png[/img]

Yeah.

That's pretty much it.[/center]
And aside from the Rusty Key, he'll also give you an extra random surprise gift.

﻿[img]https://imgur.com/mxq9tcd.png[/img]


[center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/wwAPiJi.gif[/img]﻿[/center]Just unzip the file and drop to the [b]Mods[/b] folder in Stardew Valley. Requires the following:

- [b]SMAPI
[/b]- [b]Content Patcher

[/b]
Select the mode you play in: [b]Base Game (Vanilla)[/b] or [b]Stardew Valley Expanded.[/b]

Portraits, sprites and dialogues are enabled by default but you can toggle them through the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu.
[/b][img]https://imgur.com/2kJTit5.png[/img]﻿﻿
[center]﻿[/center][center]﻿[img]https://imgur.com/Ht8BvMC.gif[/img][/center][color=#f1c232][b]6/10/2023 update:[/b] Now compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded. ^^[/color]


 [b]NOT[/b] yet compatible with:
[b]
- Gunther mods[/b] that make him [i]dateable & marriageable[/i]

(Currently WIP & testing compatibility with Make Gunther Real mod :3 )


Only tested on PC. [b]NOT [/b]yet tested on:

[b]-Android
- Stardew Valley 1.6 alpha/beta[/b]

Downloads.Description: Added compatibility with Stardew Valley Expanded -- select the SDV mode you play (Base Game or SVE) in the Settings. Also added custom dialogue that overrides majority of Gunther's lines to fit Sebastian more (can be toggled on/off in the settings).
